title: RMM Monitoring & Alert Tuning — Noise Reduction & Actionable Alerting
author_notes: Derived from a Microsoft Cloud Solution Architect (MSP) requirement: tune monitoring, alerting, and automation policies to reduce noise and surface real issues earlier.

Scope: a measurable methodology to tune an existing RMM's monitoring/alerting/automation — severity taxonomy, thresholds/hysteresis/auto-close, dedup/correlation, business-hours routing, alert-to-ticket mapping, self-heal automations, and a noise-reduction baseline. Vendor-agnostic. White-label.
pricing: T2 (standard) — focused single-platform tuning methodology.
